text:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: High error rate (5xx) and queue depth on /v1/embeddings (region-us-west). 90s avg queue depth > 120. Paging on-call.

anika: I'm on it. seeing tail latencies spike and a lot of inflight growth. putting myself as pager.

mike_s: grabbed logs, looks like a few tenants are spiking embed throughput (third-party partner). traffic is bursty and causing long KV cache churn.

oliver: can we throttle at ingress? we have per-tenant burst tokens but they aren't kicking in fast enough.

anika: starting with soft tenant cap for the top offending tenant (tenant:capstone). will reduce to 15 r/s for embeds.

kate: FYI cust-success flagged partner; sending heads-up to Capstone.

anika: running command now:```sh
redwoodctl tenancy update --tenant capstone --rate-limit 15/s --resource embeddings
```

pagerduty-bot: Note: action applied by anika at 5182536018 (rate limit update).

mike_s: saw immediate drop in queue delta, good. but overall system still near soft limit due to inflight per-worker high. moving to adjust runtime max_inflight.

anika: proposed change: reduce max_inflight for embed runtime from 48 -> 24 for region-us-west to force shedding and lower latency tail. Any objections?

oliver: +1, prefer quick reduction. Also lower socket timeout for embeddings to 30s so hung requests free up faster.

tara: I'll push the config update to the runtime control plane. command:```json
{"component":"embedding-runner","region":"us-west","max_inflight":24,"request_timeout_s":30}
```

pagerduty-bot: CONFIG CHANGE applied by tara at 5182536036 (max_inflight=24, timeout=30s).

anika: monitoring... queue depth dropping, 5xxs trending down. keep an eye on errors classified as 503 vs 504.

mike_s: seeing more 503s initially (shedding). that's expected. putting a note to customers: temporary degraded throughput for capstone and fallback to host model.

kate: sending customer comms: "We see a traffic spike causing degraded throughput for embeddings. We've applied a temporary rate cap and runtime backpressure changes to restore latency; no data loss. We'll follow up with post-incident details." pinging account team.

cust-success: acknowledged, will coordinate customer call in 30m to explain.

anika: unmute for on-call handover in 30 min. if metrics stay stable for 15m, we'll keep cap and plan a staged rollback once partner on their throttle.

oliver: follow-up ops task: create a short-lived circuit rule to prefer compact quantized embedding model for high-throughput tenants to lower per-token CPU. filing ticket after this thread.

anika: final check: last_message_ts=5182536078 - queue depth back to 20 avg, p95 latency reduced. keeping monitoring for 1h. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: automatic paging cleared (metrics within thresholds)"
